Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Project overview 
 We are looking for a Network Engineer with French skills to join our team in Bucharest (hybrid working model) for a specialized project in the banking sector. In this role, you will be a key member of the Network Filtering team responsible for implementing firewall rules and deploying security policies across Firewall, Proxy, and WAF equipment, partnering with ITRM (Information Technology Risk Management) teams to manage network traffic flows, and conducting deep technical investigations to resolve complex security incidents.
 Meet our client 
 Our client is a major player in the European banking and financial services sector, committed to innovation, security, and high-quality software development. Working with our client means engaging with a dynamic financial environment, which requires a strong understanding of and compliance with rigorous banking rules, industry standards, and security procedures.
 Responsibilities 
Ensure the configuration and deployment of filtering rules across all relevant equipment, adhering strictly to current security policies as detailed in the "Firewall Request Management" procedure.
Maintain operational readiness (Maintien en Conditions Opérationnelles - MCO) for all Filtering security solutions.
Proactively manage incidents within the assigned scope, ensuring continuous platform monitoring and prompt response to system alerts.
Handle technical configurations and fine-tuning of tools across the network security infrastructure.
Guarantee the long-term sustainability and reliability of technical solutions, proactively managing hardware/software obsolescence.
Ensure the smooth operation, maintainability, and scalability of security applications, with particular focus on Access Controls, Log Management, and Monitoring frameworks.
Analyze and resolve technical or functional anomalies escalated by users of operational security systems.
Manage software version upgrades and technical updates across the application portfolio while preserving overall architecture consistency.
Drive and monitor key action plan indicators, ensuring high system availability and meeting strict incident resolution SLAs.
Formalize, write, and maintain robust procedural documentation to govern operational workflows and best practices.
Liaise with the Security Divisions of Business Units, Security Production teams, and Technical Architecture teams to continuously evolve risk analysis matrices, driving toward automation wherever possible.
Serve as the central technical reference point and primary liaison for third-party hardware/software vendors to manage solution integration and support.
Promote and implement IT security best practices, driving continuous service improvement and technical innovation.
 Requirements 
5+ years of experience in a similar role.
Incident Management:
ServiceNow: Proficient in logging, tracking, and managing the complete lifecycle of incidents.
Technical Troubleshooting: Strong diagnostics and resolution of connection faults and rules blocks.
JIRA: Good working knowledge of issue tracking and workflows.
Frameworks & Certifications:
Standards: In-depth understanding of NIST, CIS benchmarks, and ISO 27001.
Cisco: CCNP or CCIE certifications are highly appreciated.
F5: Professional certifications are highly valued.
Tools & Technologies:
Firewalls: Checkpoint, Fortinet, Palo Alto. Experience with change management across vast network architectures (600+ clusters and standalone devices).
Micro-segmentation: Illumio (managing approx. 30k VEN agents on VMs).
Security Operations: Diagnostics of production and security events.
Proxies: McAfee Web Gateway.
Web Application Firewalls: F5 Advanced WAF (AWAF), F5 Big-IP, Application Security Manager (ASM), Access Policy Manager (APM).
Diagnostics: Expert use of Wireshark for packet capture analysis.
Experience with Linux, Windows, and IBM Cloud infrastructure.
Practical mastery of Scrum and Kanban methodologies.
Strong approach to automation and integration pipelines.
Fluent business French (working language).
Good professional proficiency in written and spoken English.
 Benefits 
Attractive salary package according to your experience and seniority bonus;
The 13th salary depending on company’s performance;
Bonus for internal recommendations;
Meal tickets;
Private health insurance, including dental services and psychological consultations;
Flexible working hours (core-hours system);
Access to over 600 sports centers in the 7Card network;
Online language courses: English and French;
Access to the e-learning platform;
Access to technical training programs / workshops, as well as other technical events (both as a participant and as a speaker);
Development opportunities through involvement in internship & mentoring programs;
Access to soft-skills programs and workshops;
Access to various internal events and team-buildings;
Access to international opportunities for career development with challenging and exciting projects in a dynamic international working environment;
Paid days off offered for involvement in volunteering activities and for bank holidays occasion.
 Kindly note that only suitable candidates will be contacted.
